'''Sigril''' is the sister of [[Yoeli]].

==History==
She is the sister of [[Yoeli]].

She leads the [[Lastriders]] in [[Maradon]]{{Ref/book|13|24}}

== Activities ==
She sends a request for aid to the other watchposts around Saldaea. If they come, she will light a watchfire to alert the forces in the city.

At the same time, she watches Maradon from the south-east, ready to pass on the news should the city fall to the [[Shadowspawn]] army.{{Ref/book|13|24}}

Sometime later, Ituralde sends a scout via [[Traveling|Gateway]] to the ridge where she and the Lastriders were to have been watching. All that the scout found was an empty camp, the fire burning unattended.{{Ref/book|13|32}}

== Trivia ==
* Sigril is named for Sigrid Andersson, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
